nodes.text: @GBNEWS As hMPV is a cold virus, people can treat their symptoms with over-the-counter medicines, fever, stuffy nose and cough. Getting plenty of rest and staying hydrated also helps. Currently, there is no approved antiviral medicine for hMPV. Most people feel better in a few days.
